title: Tunnel-DT2026: reference build of a prescriptive road-tunnel maintenance digital twin
description: Shared data and code supporting the paper Serviceability-oriented multimodal data integration for prescriptive road-tunnel maintenance digital twins (Tunnelling and Underground Space Technology). Contents: an OWL 2 maintenance ontology aligned with AASHTO DCRT, Austroads RADS and COBie; a standards-governance module; six expert-reviewed FMEA chains extracted from AASHTO DCRT Chapter 16; SPARQL realisations of the 31 competency questions; and the Streamlit reference build with Docker packaging. Demonstration data describe two fictitious tunnels. Multimodal sensing data from the case-study tunnel are subject to operator confidentiality and are not included.
